compiler_only_output.reason: Compiler-generated base-object destructor. dScEntry_c declares its destructor out of line, so mwccarm emits all three variants; under this file's `#pragma defer_codegen off` the group emits D1, D0, D2, and D1/D0 reproduce the cartridge byte for byte at 0x02115ab8 and 0x02115b28. Nothing in the object references D2: the vtable's slots 16 and 17 name D1 and D0. config/arm9/overlays/*/symbols.txt gives _ZN10dScEntry_cD2Ev no home anywhere in the ROM, which is the cartridge saying the retail link dead-stripped the same unreferenced variant. Homeless, so a plain deadstrip rather than deadstrip-duplicate.

boundary_evidence: PARTIAL PROMOTION. The linker run holding dScEntry_c is ov075 0x02115ab8..0x0211a854, 82 functions shared with OamAnimation (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py; `tubuild list` names it ov075/OamAnimation+dScEntry_c). src/game/stages/d_s_entry.cpp licenses the contiguous sub-range 0x02115ab8..0x02116128 -- thirteen of those 82, from dScEntry_c's own D1 to func_ov075_021160dc. The class's scene methods, the RESULT factory and the OamAnimation/icon_c constructors at 0x0211a210..0x0211a854 are src/game/stages/d_s_entry_methods.cpp (manifest ov075/d_s_entry_methods), on the far side of the hole.

WHY THE UPPER SIXTY-NINE CANNOT JOIN: the next function, func_ov075_02116128 (0xf4), does not match. It is the recorded register-allocation near-miss of notes/mwccarm-codegen.md 6bo (div 20, ~60,000 compiles, the shared-TU hypothesis measured in both forms), and its source carries a NONMATCHING banner. config/arm9/overlays/ov075/delinks.txt has NO entry covering 0x02116128..0x021165b0 -- that function and func_ov075_0211621c -- so dsd serves those bytes from the ROM. src/unnamed/ov075/func_ov075_02117bc4.c is enrolled but carries no `complete` marker. A delinks entry is a single contiguous .text claim (zero of the tree's entries carry two), so a licensed range cannot step over 0x02116128; everything above it, the factories included, keeps its own shard until that function closes.

DESTRUCTOR FORM. The cartridge places dScEntry_c's D1 (0x02115ab8) BELOW its D0 (0x02115b28). Under deferred codegen the out-of-line `dScEntry_c::~dScEntry_c() {}` emitted D0 before D1 (measured at the original promotion: 13/13 bytes, but `licensed .text functions are not emitted in ROM address order`), and the in-class form emitted no pair at all because no factory is in range to instantiate the class. The form shipped here is ov003/dScStarSel_c's and ov006/dScMgFlower_c's: `#pragma defer_codegen off` above every function, the file rewritten in ROM-ascending order, and the unchanged out-of-line destructor defined first. It emits D1, D0, D2; D1 and D0 reproduce the cartridge and D2 is unreferenced and deadstripped. The destructor is dScEntry_c's first declared non-inline virtual, so this TU is the key function and now also emits _ZTV10dScEntry_c and the typeinfo chain up to fBase_c, each deadstrip-data against its cartridge home.

WHAT THE WIDENED RANGE PROVED. `python tools/tubuild.py verify ov075/dScEntry_c`: 13/13 MATCH, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean, all 13 in ROM-ascending emission order, compiler-only policy accepted. `tubuild linkcheck` refuses an already-enrolled text-only TU (see verification.linkcheck), so the link proof is the full `python tools/rombuild.py -j8`: 106/106 modules exact, 0 mismatching, ROM-build analysis PASS. The original promotion's SCRATCH-LINK-VERIFIED record for 0x02115bac..0x02116128 is kept in verification.linkcheck; `dsd check symbols --fail` failed there on 9 error lines, all 9 present in the baseline control too, so it was not green then and is not reported as such now.

THE FIVE HOMELESS COMPILER-ONLY FUNCTIONS ARE NOT DUPLICATES. _ZN10dScEntry_cD2Ev, _ZN10dScEntry_c6icon_cD2Ev, _ZN10dScEntry_c6icon_cD0Ev, _ZN12OamAnimationD2Ev and _ZN10dScEntry_c15graphCallback_cC2Ev are emitted by mwccarm and defined by no symbols.txt in the tree, so they take a plain `deadstrip`, not `deadstrip-duplicate` (which requires a configured ROM home another source owns). The nineteen RTTI/vtable records take `deadstrip-data`; every canonical home is in .data, outside the claimed .text run.

UPDATE 2026-10-15, SUPERSEDES THE NEAR-MISS REASON ABOVE: func_ov075_02116128 now matches (commit 9a3ed3a8a5; notes/mwccarm-codegen.md '6bo resolved'), and every function in 0x02116128..0x0211a210 has its own `complete` delinks entry -- 69 one-function sources, a mix of .c and .cpp. What keeps this range from widening is no longer a mismatch: joining the two parts means folding those 69 files into one C++ source. Referrer census over every relocs.txt: no code outside this class reaches any of them; they are called from dScEntry_c::InitResources/Behavior, from one another, or reached through the step tables __sinit_ov075_0211bb00 copies into .bss, and that initializer also constructs dScEntry_c::graphCallback_c, so it belongs to this unit.
